packets.title: One costly promise leaves stress and a coping habit
packets.proposal: An opt-in home-world promise conflicts with one established habit. Breaking it adds stress; a relief choice leaves a modest persistent habit and one dated aftereffect. Preserve vanilla entry and recovery.
packets.acceptance: Fresh-origin promise choice, insufficient prerequisite, one relief consequence, later event, save/reload/import preserve exact habit and due time.
packets.state: proposal only; balance and psychological labels original; no gameplay implemented

packets.title: A confidant is a person, not a stress button
packets.proposal: One existing NPC can become a trusted contact through a paid-in-time conversation. A saved bond selects later dialogue, with an availability gate and routine cooldown.
packets.acceptance: First conversation creates bond, repeat uses it, absent NPC blocks it without consuming cooldown; reload/import preserve relation and date.

packets.title: An heirloom choice leaves a family rival
packets.proposal: At one optional family milestone, choose who receives a keepsake; excluded relative remembers the choice. A later reconciliation changes eligibility/opinion without deleting the biography. No forced death/prestige design.
packets.acceptance: Two candidates, one transfer, later rival callback, reversal retains old milestone, save/reload/import agree.
packets.state: proposal only; requires accepted family/legacy scope

packets.title: Semantic memory retention and safe participant tombstones
packets.proposal: Store event kind/date/world/actor IDs and compact context, render text later. Use short ordinary retention and longer player/family/rival milestones. Before dropping full NPC state, preserve tombstone facts needed by retained memories; bound live references, rather than pinning whole NPC forever.
packets.acceptance: Long simulated life size budget; still-active event and milestone references survive compaction; expired routine memories retire; stable replay/save/reload/import and unknown-ID fallback.
packets.boundary: These are original browser-engine policies inspired by shipped contracts. CK3 native serializer, compression codec, graph prune algorithm and byte budgets remain unrecovered.
packets.state: proposal only; compare existing life_record/npc_lives owners before integration

packets.title: Separate authored starting history from played-life deltas
packets.proposal: Keep immutable content facts outside save; save only player-caused deltas and compact milestones with content-version-aware ID lookup. Coarse NPC years consume retained outcomes rather than replaying all prose.
packets.acceptance: Baseline absent from exported payload, changed facts survive version migration/reload/import; missing content ID uses preserved minimal fact instead of losing biography.
packets.boundary: No claim CK3 implements this exact save strategy; history source schema alone cannot establish native compaction.

integration_constraints: Read live state owners before implementation; other writers retain ownership
Vanilla opening and original center UI remain intact
No forced death, restart or universal family system accepted here
Source audit is not gameplay acceptance; fresh browser build/save/reload/import gates remain for implementers
